text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-san, class is about to start. 
You're pretty late... Did something 
happen?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...The lock on the bathroom door broke... 
and it won't open..."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even the wind cannot reach it... The air 
is stagnant and heavy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr was utterly exhausted after 
being trapped in the restroom due to a 
mishap.
